evidence.quote: Move work out of the request only when the caller can continue without its result.

mechanisms.reason: Producer/broker/worker state transitions explain two acknowledgements; the crash gap motivates stable-ID uniqueness and effect in one transaction. Backoff/quarantine, per-entity serialized effects including retries, arithmetic backlog growth and independent retained-log positions make failures traceable.

evidence.quote: Trace publish → broker acceptance → worker effect → consumer acknowledgement. The client observes completion through status.

coherence.reason: HTTP, atomic database changes and rates are stated prerequisites. All eight card objectives build from deferred acceptance through handoff, duplicates, failure isolation, ordering, overload, queue/log distinction and request-boundary decision. Inspected acknowledgement and work-sharing/log-group diagrams preserve the boundaries; shared renderer/CSS inspected earlier, not run.

evidence.quote: Expect repeated delivery; make the effect duplicate-safe at its own boundary.

decisions.reason: The stack pairs deferred-response benefit with broker/status/retry operation costs, rejects asynchronous dependent authorization, bounds overload and poisoned work, limits hot-entity throughput, and chooses independent retained history only with retention and effect safety.

evidence.quote: A dead-letter queue contains failure; it does not repair the job.

clarity.reason: Short role definitions and concrete balance-credit/address-order/rate examples make causal distinctions clear. Consumer groups, partitions and offsets are explained without suggesting global ordering, deletion on commit or unlimited replay.

evidence.quote: Ordered delivery alone does not guarantee ordered effects.

outcomes.reason: Actual learner traces API publish, confirmed configured broker handoff, worker rendering and saved result/status, then consumer ack. It provides pending/ready/failed observation, retains synchronous access decisions and names worker/backlog operation cost.

Actual learner traces post-credit pre-ack crash redelivery and early-ack loss; stable operation ID plus unique durable record and credit in one atomic transaction handles races/crash gaps. Duplicate effect safety is explicitly scoped, not universal delivery or external-effect exactly-once.

Actual learner gives delayed finite retry budget for transient storage failure, immediate isolation for unsupported format, exhausted dead-letter and failed status, continued healthy work, cause correction and prior-effect/duplicate-safety checks before replay. Exact delay numbers are not required.

Actual learner concludes wrong final 5, distinguishes receipt/effect order, serializes same-item effects through retry, permits different-item concurrency, resolves dead-letter dependency and names hot-item serial throughput cost.

Actual learner computes 40 jobs/second growth, connects oldest age to delayed completion, bounds worker calls to saturated store, visibly throttles/rejects or boundedly defers admission, and conditions buffering and worker expansion on finite limits and downstream headroom.

Actual learner contrasts divided queue jobs with independent billing/analytics log groups, within-group partition sharing and per-group offsets. Offset progress does not delete retained records; one-day replay requires those records remain. Order is per partition and external effects need separate coordination.

sourceChecks.claim: Previously inspected live Azure asynchronous-request-reply guidance supports accepted response with status polling and eventual success/failure, not completed work at acceptance.
